result.title: Markov-Equivalent Conditional Independence Graphs on Path Spaces
result.summary: Causal discovery for continuous-time stochastic processes with latent confounding typically faces a trade-off between (i) approaches that are highly informative about the causal structure but are difficult to test statistically, and (ii) approaches that admit practical tests from data but yield more coarse-grained conclusions, potentially not leveraging the direction of time. We introduce W-separation, an asymmetric graphical criterion for directed mixed graphs defined as a quaternary relation that allows distinct conditioning on past and future components. This added flexibility yields a highly informative graphical independence model while preserving testability. W-separation satisfies a global Markov property for a broad class of stochastic differential equations with latent confounding, linking it to conditional independence relations among coordinate processes that are testable from data. A central result of this work is the full characterization of W-Markov equivalence classes: we show that every equivalence class admits a unique greatest element that serves as a canonical representative and a principled target for learning algorithms. In addition, we provide necessary and sufficient conditions under which directed or bidirected edges can be added without altering the induced independence model.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 W-separation：一种对有向混合图定义的非对称图形判据，允许对过去与未来成分分别条件化，并证明它对一类含隐混杂的随机微分方程满足全局 Markov 性质，同时完整刻画 W-Markov 等价类及其唯一最大元。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「隐变量下时序过程的因果图判据与等价类」概念或可为形式化 latent 推理状态对答案的因果贡献、以及多步状态间的混杂结构提供参照，但属连续时间 SDE 理论，与 VLM 推理无可直接迁移线索，是否可用需核查。
